spine: Distinguish participation from authority, then examine bounded custody, selective cooperation and survivable exit.
art: A source-derived archipelago of autonomous workshops carrying one common promise; selected exchanges cross between islands, a local fault stays local, and an exiting node keeps its history.
lines: Decentralised Brands asks how autonomous organizations could share a promise without surrendering their future.
Here a brand is an institution of rules, trust, reputation, and coordinated action.
The book distinguishes genuine limits on central power from participation that leaves ownership untouched.
It develops cooperation through explicit responsibilities, selective interoperability, and meaningful possibilities for exit.
Readers gain tests for examining a proposed institution, rather than assuming decentralization guarantees democracy.
